rankings_and_accreditations.detail: IU Dehradun is notified by the UGC under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956, and is competent to award degrees under Section 22 of the Act.
IU Dehradun is accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC).
Law programs at ICFAI Law School are approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI), with approval renewed annually.
Teacher-education programs at ICFAI Education School are approved by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).
The B.Pharmacy program at ICFAI School of Pharmaceutical Sciences is approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

As a State Act university (not an AICTE-affiliated institution), IU Dehradun does not require AICTE approval; this is confirmed by the university citing the Bharathidasan University v. AICTE Supreme Court judgment.
ICFAI Law School, Dehradun is a corporate member of the Law Association for Asia and the Pacific (LAWASIA).
IU Dehradun has received an E-LEAD certification recognising its digital learning ecosystem and virtual-education preparedness.
Member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
Member of the Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU).
